changes.summary: The AFL Free Agents page was hiding every player still rostered in the OTHER conference — so a guy dropped in your conference (looking at you, Kyle Pitts) never showed up as available. Availability is now tracked per conference, and roster moves hit the page within a minute of happening on MFL instead of waiting for the next site deploy. (The conference-scoped view that landed with this got its own What's New article.)

NFL team and college logos no longer show up as broken-image icons in dark mode on spotty connections — the site now serves its own copies of the dark logo sets instead of leaning on ESPN's servers every time a page renders.
